description: Exploit: spend Muon's accuracy gain on epochs. Start from the I032 result if it was kept as the Muon base, otherwise from E025 (commit 50d39d6). Change only the epoch count, from 11 to 9.5. Rescale the LR, Lookahead and Muon schedules to the new step count so they still anneal fully, and keep the 24 px phase at the first 50% of steps. Report per-seed accuracy. If the 3-seed mean margin over 0.753 is under 0.3 pp, rerun once and pool before promoting it (H1.1.3 rule).
